_key.description: Variant key and coding variant key joined by an underscore. Hashed with SHA-256 when the composite would exceed the 254-character key limit.

_from.description: Document handle of the genomic variant.

_to.description: Document handle of the coding variant this genomic variant produces.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction: the genomic variant codes for this coding variant.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction: the coding variant is encoded by this genomic variant.

chr.description: Chromosome the genomic variant lies on, prefixed with 'chr'.

pos.description: Position of the genomic variant on the chromosome, 0-based, taken from its SPDI expression.

ref.description: Reference allele of the genomic variant, on the forward strand.

alt.description: Alternate allele of the genomic variant, on the forward strand.

label.description: The relationship this edge represents, phrased for display.

source.description: The dataset this edge was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the IGVF file this edge was derived from.
